name: dev.alephgrid/alephgrid
description: Read-only MCP access to Alephgrid workbooks: schema cards, reads, SQL, saved queries, receipts.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for an agent connection, created in Alephgrid under a space or workbook (shown once, prefixed agc_)

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.notes: Alephgrid is a self-hosted, open-source spreadsheet (Apache-2.0). There is no hosted endpoint at alephgrid.dev: every Alephgrid server exposes its own Streamable HTTP endpoint at <server origin>/mcp, and ships a stdio bridge: `alephgrid mcp --url <server origin> --token agc_...`. Connections are read-only and scoped to one space or workbook; every result carries a content-hashed receipt. Setup guide: https://alephgrid.dev/docs/agents-mcp/ — machine-readable docs: https://alephgrid.dev/llms.txt
